Module io.github.jpersist.tools.hibernate.orm

module io.github.jpersist.tools.hibernate.orm
Hibernate ORM 6 provider implementation for Jakarta Persistence ("jakarta" namespace).

This module provides runtime and build-time persistence tooling for applications targeting Jakarta Persistence specifications (JPA 3.0, 3.1, and 3.2). It registers factory implementations for bytecode enhancement, semantic query model (SQM) query parsing, and database schema validation using Hibernate ORM 6.

Provided Services

  • NamedObjectParserFactory – provided by HibernateNamedObjectParserFactory
  • SchemaValidatorFactory – provided by HibernateSchemaValidatorFactory
  • EnhancerProvider – provided by HibernateEnhancerProvider
